compatibility.statement: Compatible with Harness Kernel protocol 3.0. Version 1.0.0 requires a concrete target-project task.md containing the Web professional execution plan, complete user-visible Markdown presentation, and explicit confirmation of the current digest before mutating implementation. It preserves the Domain's framework-neutral semantics, accessibility, security, privacy, compatibility, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries. Projects pinned to 0.x retain the earlier workflow and must migrate their Kernel before adopting 1.0.0.
